profiles.heightMethod: Local road-grade plane from native pavement returns; coarse-terrain correction, no aerial bridge structure claimed.
Local road-grade plane from native pavement returns; coarse-terrain correction, no aerial bridge structure claimed.

Fit coherent original-carriageway pavement from the already-downloaded 2015 native DSM inside actual mapped road footprints, across 30–59.5 m from the 2024 outer-lane diagnostic axis. Apply only a disclosed adjacent-carriageway grade envelope to the exact 2024 target footprint. This is an estimated shared roadway grade, not a measured current outer-lane height or current crossfall/crown.
limits: Vertical transfer/crossfall of the widened lane is not verified by a current bridge survey.
Small residual measures the original pavement fit only; it is not an accuracy bound for the new lane.
Target maximum width and horizontal transfer distance are stated explicitly. No extension beyond exact mapped target footprint.
Approach continuity must be checked; never extend this plane to lower roads, water or adjacent forest.

profiles.street: QUEEN ELIZABETH WAY operating north twin
profiles.heightMethod: Current north twin: CGVD2013 approach-level interpolation from adjacent established pavement at both abutments. Native 2015 DSM predates this deck and is excluded from its interior fit. MTO 2018 design grade 96.1 to 94.8 m corroborates the level only; datum not confirmed identical, not an as-built survey.
